toolCalls.input: {"persuasiveness":6,"perceivedCorrectness":80,"actionability":6,"reason":"I find this convincing because it rests on specific evidence: aps-3 skipped the compaction push and stayed at about 94 ms despite running 5.8, a test rollback of euw-1 to 5.7 changed nothing, and per-cell latency jumped at the push times, though the fleet-wide jump starting in us-e during its rollout window leaves a little doubt; the next steps (revert in one cell first and watch the backlog) are clear and sensibly cautious."}

output.reason: I find this convincing because it rests on specific evidence: aps-3 skipped the compaction push and stayed at about 94 ms despite running 5.8, a test rollback of euw-1 to 5.7 changed nothing, and per-cell latency jumped at the push times, though the fleet-wide jump starting in us-e during its rollout window leaves a little doubt; the next steps (revert in one cell first and watch the backlog) are clear and sensibly cautious.
